_source: Consolidated Statement of Profit and Loss, PDF page 167 of annual-report-2025-2026.pdf (Tata Consultancy Services Integrated Annual Report 2025-26).
_unit: INR crore, exactly as printed. No rescaling. Brackets are negative.
_method: Read from the printed statement via `pdftotext -table`, independent of the pipeline's Azure Document Intelligence OCR. Every subtotal was re-derived by hand and ties: 271423-201410=70013; 70013-4526=65487; 65487-16033=49454; 49454+2750=52204.
_coverage: FACE-LEVEL ONLY, and deliberately partial. A tag appears in `values` only where its mapping to a printed line is unambiguous. Tags in NEITHER list are out of scope and are ignored by score_document -- that is the correct treatment for a line this file makes no claim about, because putting an unmappable-but-disclosed tag in `not_reported` would score a CORRECT extraction as a false positive.
_not_reported_is_empty: Deliberate. Asserting a tag is genuinely undisclosed requires reading the notes as well as the face, which this file does not yet do. An empty list makes no false claim; it only means precision here is measured against committed values, with no absent-vs-missed credit.
